object_description: two distinct independent volumes forming a compact school campus
design_condition: Two independent volumes are positioned apart from the existing building to form a campus arrangement, but the southern volume substantially reduces the site's green leisure area.

positive.statement: The two distinct volumes cleverly formulate a school campus.

position.rationale: The separated south-west and north-east masses visibly establish the campus composition.

positive.statement: The clear layout creates a precise urban relationship and integrates the existing complex convincingly into its built environment.

position.rationale: The distributed volumes and intervening open space define the broader urban relationship.

positive.statement: The project strategy is convincing in many respects and shows considerable care in its formulation.

position.rationale: The overall arrangement is represented by the compact cluster and its clear separation.

negative.statement: The southern building takes away much of the green leisure area and prevents outdoor activities without a comparable alternative.

position.target: southern building and green leisure area
position.rationale: The large southern mass occupies the south-west portion where leisure open space would otherwise remain.
